hypotheses.summary: Add P mutation flags and compiler state directly to the existing runtime judgment subject.
predicted_effect: required flags become available
existing judgment module gains compile and persistence coupling
falsifier: the extension remains responsibility-isolated without widening J runtime

hypotheses.summary: Represent the correction only as documents and registries.
predicted_effect: operator intent becomes auditable
runtime compile promotion and rollback remain unenforced
falsifier: documents alone prevent an unowned active P mutation

hypotheses.summary: Compose a separate HDS-owned P update control layer with the existing judgment memory and compiler subjects.
predicted_effect: active candidate and previous-stable slots remain disjoint
compile promotion and rollback require exact HDS-owned grants
existing runtime judgment responsibilities remain unchanged
applicability: symbolic parametric and hybrid instruction-body updates
offline development and runtime learning loops

hypotheses.summary: Observe the required actor anchor during merge animations without changing placement policy.
predicted_effect: actor chase drift becomes explicit
existing placement can still lose the required actor

hypotheses.summary: Assign fruit to the rendered target farthest from the required terminal actor.
predicted_effect: fruit placement moves away from the actor
four-frame chase can still displace the actor

hypotheses.summary: Avoid currently rendered animation rings while routing fruit.
predicted_effect: immediate ring collisions decrease
future unselected actor motion remains unprotected
falsifier: ring avoidance alone closes the target

hypotheses.summary: Move the rendered required terminal actor to a safe anchor before fruit placement and reobserve four bounded transitions.
predicted_effect: required actor remains outside the fruit chase path
target closes without fixed identity or coordinates
applicability: rendered equal-rank merge with explicit terminal actor goal

hypotheses.summary: Port a complete visible transition model before adding a new semantic commitment operator.
predicted_effect: more action effects become predictable
commit conditions remain unresolved
falsifier: transition coverage alone completes a target level

hypotheses.summary: Replace raw visual signatures with explicit structural role and phase representations.
predicted_effect: equivalent rendered states share evidence
new role induction is required before action selection changes
applicability: repeated state changes with unresolved roles
falsifier: raw signatures already preserve every required role

hypotheses.summary: Reorder existing explorer prototypes so verified progress is followed by globally unobserved action effects.
predicted_effect: known changing actions stop monopolizing selection
at least one bounded diagnostic gains level progress
applicability: state-changing exploration with unobserved action prototypes
falsifier: action diversity changes without any completed-level delta

hypotheses.summary: Add a rendered relation operator that identifies selectable objects, enclosing targets, and an intervening barrier.
predicted_effect: selection points and displacement counts derive from geometry
the bounded target advances from zero to one completed level
applicability: paired border objects with paired enclosing targets and barrier

hypotheses.summary: Infer movable, selectable, target, and barrier roles from observed transition deltas.
predicted_effect: post-level layouts can update role assignments
additional probe transitions are required
applicability: rendered role layouts that change after progress
falsifier: transition deltas do not disambiguate roles

hypotheses.summary: Compose existing object-target control and route planning after the selectable relation is detected.
predicted_effect: existing transition learning handles altered target layouts
selection semantics may remain underdetermined
applicability: selectable rendered objects with learned movement
falsifier: existing operators cannot preserve selection state
